name: @voqalize/demo-colegioeverest-extension
description: Puts Javier, the colegioeverest demo brain's guide, on colegioeverest.cl: a Chrome extension that injects the call widget and the site adapter, fills the contact form as the visitor dictates it (they press Enviar), and holds one call, in an offscreen document, across every Colegio Everest tab and page load.

scripts.gen: cd ../.. && uv run voqalize types colegioeverest/backend/brain.py -o colegioeverest/extension/src/actions.gen.ts
